limits: Current gersdorffite is P213, while pre2022 literature may include Pa3/Pca21; no phase assignment is inferred from NiAsS formula alone.
Mauro natural crystals are zoned, substituted and occur in mixed aggregates; geological formation interpretation is not a controlled transformation experiment.

Mauro main Table3 reports293(2)K/535 measured reflections versus CIF296(2)K/526; small coordinate reporting differences and Table5 printed average bond distance are not imported. P213 and cell parameter agree.
GFC historical30.6% mineralogy is inherited; mixed feed also includes nickeline,pentlandite,pyrrhotite,pyrite and silicate/carbonate. No species-resolved dissolution balance.

GFC lowactivity/null result is contextual. pH3.0 hasFeII/S0 additions whereas pH2.5 does not; controls were inoculated then autoclaved, one per arm. Weekly5mL sampling and solute-volume correction uncertainty prevent a recovered-product balance.
DGGE reference accessions/closest matches do not identify causal strains; no species-specific microbial mechanism entered.
Wakeman2011 full journal methods, original graphics and any SI remain unavailable through the bounded routes screened. No abstract-derived extraction claim accepted.
